title: ze_offliner
description: The ending: the Green Sphere's laser corridor, the 8 lasers after its floor breaks, and the look-up finale's falling blades and rings.

fix-broken-respawn-toggle.name: Respawn turned off once
fix-broken-respawn-toggle.summary: The ending turns respawn off, instead of toggling it on every touch
fix-broken-respawn-toggle.detail: once_end_win (the ending's win area) sends zr_toggle_respawn Trigger, which flips zombie respawn each time it fires. GFL changes it to Disable, so respawn is off however many times it fires. Off: the map's toggle.

scenarios.name: Ending (full)
scenarios.summary: Green Sphere, the 8 lasers, the look-up finale
scenarios.description: From the final door to the end: walk west through pushtoboss (each human adds 70 to end_laser_counter, which starts at 50, max 1500) and shoot the Green Sphere while its lasers come down the corridor. Its death (end_laser_counter OnHitMin) breaks the floor at +7 s, fires 8 final lasers at +12 to +18 s, opens the wall at +19.5 s to the teleport into the finale, where blades fall from the spinning maker above (+30.2 to +62 s) and rings drop (+32 to +62 s). Win when once_end_win (enabled at +66 s) fires final_nuke.

scenarios.name: Green Sphere boss
scenarios.summary: Shoot the sphere, jump and duck its lasers
scenarios.description: Walk west through pushtoboss: add_hp_toboss adds 70 per human to end_laser_counter (starts at 50, max 1500; GFL's BossHUD shows it as "Green Sphere"). The sphere (end_laser_breakable) spawns at +0.5 s and takes hits from +3 s, each bullet 1 off the counter. From +1.5 s end_laser_timer fires a laser every 0.7-1.1 s from the sphere down the corridor at 1400 u/s: two low (jump), one high (duck) and two tilted 5 degrees. They kill, and each human they hit takes 40 off the counter. Win when the counter reaches 0 (end_laser_breakable.Break).

scenarios.name: After the sphere: the 8 lasers
scenarios.summary: Face the 8 lasers and dodge them
scenarios.description: Starts as the Green Sphere dies (end_laser_counter OnHitMin). You stand on the sphere's platform at the west end, facing back down the corridor: at +7 s ending_break drops the floor between you and falldown_miss, leaving 7 pillars over a pit that kills (human-only trigger_hurt). final_laser_case fires 8 lasers at +12, 13, 14, 15, 15.7, 16.4, 17.2 and 18 s, each one of three heights (two to jump, one to duck), flying west at 1650 u/s from x -9424 straight at you. Win when the last one has passed (+19.5 s, as the wall behind you breaks). On the map you then have until +25 s to take the teleport behind that wall: last_zm_tp sends everyone left in the level to the zombie cage.

scenarios.name: Finale: look up
scenarios.summary: Dodge the blades falling from above
scenarios.description: The arena the wall's teleport leads to (last_human_dest), 20.5 s after the sphere's death; the gradient fog is off, as the wall's teleport turns it off for every human who passes. From +24.8 s the maker above spins (very_end_rotate_cube, speed re-rolled every 0.02-0.04 s, sometimes reversed) and slides in and out on very_end_dodge_random_door. From +30.2 s it drops a blade every 0.06-0.09 s (1660 u/s, kills), from +32 s a ring falls every 2-4 s (l10, kills). Both stop at +62 s; win when once_end_win (enabled at +66 s) fires final_nuke.
